final_scoped_conclusion: Under original-model certification, matched deterministic expressiveness, frozen replay, end-to-end accounting, and preregistered stopping rules, the evaluated program retains zero defensible LLM-specific solved-set or search-efficiency advantage.

requirements: Use a new branch or repository with an independently stated research question.
Freeze a new population and preregistration before observing outcomes.
Do not select cases because they rescue a failed or not-run soundness-audit hypothesis.
Treat cross-tool audit, translation-validated proof reuse, and source-level repair as separate studies.

gates.hypothesis: LLM-generated mutex hints inserted as BTOR2 constraints produce safety proofs of the original transition systems.
gates.observed_result: All 32 independently checkable old proofs were rejected; 30 of 32 tested mutex conjunctions were reachable and none was established as a true invariant.
prohibited_interpretations: Constraint-injected UNSAT results are not proofs of the original models.
The early audit predates the unified result-artifact schema; no retroactive result bundle may be fabricated.
gates.threshold: Every accepted proof must independently satisfy C1, C2, and C3 on the original unconstrained BTOR2 model.
gates.title: Constraint-hint soundness audit

gates.hypothesis: Untrusted LLM formulas can guide IC3IA as abstraction predicates without under-approximating the concrete model.
gates.observed_result: The implemented initial-predicate path refines IC3IA abstraction vocabulary and preserves original-model proof semantics; false candidate formulas affect efficiency, not soundness.
prohibited_interpretations: An abstraction predicate is not itself a certified invariant.
A false candidate may still cause runtime or memory regressions.
gates.threshold: Initial predicates must leave concrete init, transition, constraints, and BAD properties unchanged, and every safety verdict must remain a verdict on the original model.
gates.title: Sound predicate-injection boundary

gates.hypothesis: The corrected full21 corpus contains LLM-specific affine or quadratic proof capacity after a deterministic baseline of matched expressiveness.
gates.observed_result: LLM Houdini and deterministic quadratic Houdini solve the same seven cases; both engine portfolios reach eight UNSAT and two SAT, leaving an empty LLM-specific UNSAT set.
prohibited_interpretations: The three affine and two nonlinear examples cannot be called LLM-only.
Ten of ten successful nonlinear captures establish reliability only, not marginal proof value.
gates.threshold: An LLM-specific solve must remain outside the engine plus matched deterministic affine/quadratic portfolio and pass direct original-model certification.
gates.title: Matched affine and quadratic full21 baseline

gates.hypothesis: A broader deterministic-hard HWMCC residual contains an LLM-only proof or a defensible LLM compactness advantage.
gates.observed_result: The 11-target gate has zero LLM-specific solve; cap-200 static seeding and a smaller, faster fixed relational ranker reproduce the apparent up.btor2 result.
prohibited_interpretations: up.btor2 is not an LLM-specific proof or compactness win.
A helpful abstraction basis does not establish uniqueness of its provider.
gates.threshold: Any apparent LLM solve must survive matched deterministic static and fixed low-complexity ranked baselines under the frozen proof budget.
gates.title: Broader HWMCC and compactness gate

gates.hypothesis: Source representation, phase conditioning, or LLM grammar routing provides a generalizable advantage over matched target views and deterministic structural routing.
gates.observed_result: Source adds no unique solve; phase conditioning adds one of the required three; structural routing covers the full three-task LLM union; H4 soundness passes with zero unsafe false-safe.
prohibited_interpretations: The one phase-only result cannot be described as phase generalization.
Invalid routes may not be repaired or silently removed from the denominator.
The result is scoped to the frozen paired pilot and does not prove source information is universally useless.
gates.threshold: Source must add a unique certified solve, phase conditioning must add at least three independent natural proofs, and LLM routing must beat deterministic structural routing with sound end-to-end utility.
gates.title: Paired representation, phase, and grammar gate

gates.hypothesis: A strict equal-width modular-polynomial certificate kernel improves proof checking on a preregistered natural nonlinear population.
gates.observed_result: The natural primary population is empty: 39 tasks require arrays, 221 have no supported nonlinear SCC, and the remaining seven exceed the frozen eight-branch cap. Development H5c passes; H5a is not run and H5b is not authorized.
prohibited_interpretations: Not-run is neither evidence of kernel utility nor evidence of kernel failure.
Development controls or synthetic cases may not replace the absent natural primary population.
The branch cap or operator language may not be widened retroactively.
gates.threshold: At least three independent natural source families must be v1-eligible and show timeout conversion or at least tenfold gain over the best exact generic baseline with zero false-safe.
gates.title: Proof-carrying modular algebraic feasibility gate

gates.hypothesis: Six frozen nonlinear candidates are true invariants blocked only by helpers, deeper induction, or proof organization.
gates.observed_result: All six candidates violate C1 in an initial state and are removed by exact Houdini; they are false candidates rather than valid invariants with a proof-organization gap.
prohibited_interpretations: The six candidates may not be described as valid invariants needing repair.
Replacing or repairing them after observing C1 witnesses is a different experiment.
gates.threshold: A candidate must first satisfy C1 and survive exact Houdini before helper, k-induction, or proof-graph work is applicable.
gates.title: Frozen nonlinear inductiveness-gap decomposition

gates.hypothesis: The existing certified source-invariant population is sufficient for a non-trivial known-map transport oracle across three primary transform families.
gates.observed_result: The census finds 11 certified bases and six affine-recoding-applicable bases, below the frozen 12/8 requirements; it stops before variant generation, map validation, utility timing, or LLM/API calls.
prohibited_interpretations: No transport correctness, speedup, or mapping result was measured.
The 12/8 thresholds may not be lowered to 11/6 after census inspection.
Alternate binaries, machines, repeated widths, or synthetic transforms may not retroactively refill the population.
gates.threshold: At least 12 certified safe bases, eight independent families, and eight applicable bases for each primary transform are required before any transformed variant or utility run.
gates.title: Known-map certified-transport population gate

post_boundary_addenda.scope: Oracle-First capability indexing and a public external-artifact availability census; no new Pono mechanism, transformation, proof repair, or LLM/API experiment.

program.scope: Sound integration and matched-baseline evaluation of LLM-guided IC3IA on evaluated software-origin BTOR2 populations.
